Matter submitted, in accordance with Article 272(c) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, to amend Article 191 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis

Bringing the following amendment to the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis.

1. Amending Article 191 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis as follows.

[?] [?] order

191. Any Member of the Majlis may present a party [unclear]. The following order shall apply to bills and statement parties [unclear]. That is:

(a) the bill [?] [?] having been drawn up in the parties [unclear];

(b) the debate and information taking place among the parties present not being to one party [unclear];

(c) the vote to accept the party [unclear] shall be taken before the confidence and debate opportunity; if it is passed that there is an opportunity to accept the party, after the confidence and debate, that party [?] [?] that party's [?]. If it is not passed that there is an opportunity to accept the party, that party shall be void. No further debate may be held on that party [?].

(d) once the successful stage is completed and that party is passed by the Majlis, deciding to send the bill for ratification [?] for ratification in the original.

2. This amendment shall take effect from the date the People's Majlis passes this amendment.
